stlscale Engine

Free browser-based tool for 3D printed miniatures

The core tool of STLACCESS. Select source and target scales, choose eye-level or top-of-head measurement, and get the exact slicer percentage. Supports Warhammer 40k, D&D, Bolt Action, Star Wars Legion, Shatterpoint, scale model kits, and display pieces. No file upload, no login, no tracking.

Features

15+ gaming scales supported
Eye Level and Top of Head measurement
Bed-level calibration guides
Copy to clipboard and save to library
Deep-linkable via URL parameters

Ready to use it?

stlscale Engine runs in your browser. No account, no download, no cost.

Launch stlscale Engine
